d:
This horror is scripted. Your goosebumps are not.
When a lab-grown vegan meat develops teeth, the company owners face an escalating set of moral dilemmas, as the situation spirals out of control.
"Happy Meat" by Matt Green
Connect with the Filmmakers:
More About "Happy Meat":
‘Happy meat Inc.’ had a dream. They had a dream to save the world. They had a dream to make a genetically modified lab-grown super-meat; to reduce emissions and put an end to the needless suffering of innocent animals. And in the process get stinking rich.
